purpose: Provide official-domain and address-enriched versions of three existing batch 171 candidates before the original batch input is consumed. Duplicate parcel_ids are intentional and do not create new candidates.
geometry_policy: Published addresses constrain the canonical runner search area but are not exact parcel polygons. No coordinate, centroid, footprint or geometry is asserted by ChatGPT.

features.name: One Park Drive

features.map_source_evidence: Use 1 Park Drive, Wood Wharf, London E14 9GG to isolate the cylindrical tower footprint. Do not bind the wider Wood Wharf estate or adjacent public realm.

features.web_source_evidence: Official-domain identity plus consistent architectural and occupancy evidence directly supports the Office Building classification.
features.map_source_evidence: Bind only the tower footprint at 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N. Exclude neighbouring Bishopsgate and Crosby Square buildings from the parcel match.
